description: Tool to retrieve a single GA4 Property by its resource name. Use when you need detailed property configuration including display name, time zone, currency, and other settings.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a single GA4 Property.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the Property to retrieve. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id} where property_id is a numeric identifier. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain no forward slashes in the property_id, have no trailing slashes, and no additional path segments. Valid example: 'properties/489591273'. Invalid examples: '489591273' (missing prefix), 'properties/489591273/' (trailing slash), 'properties/489591273/extra' (extra segments)
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: GetPropertyRequest

name: get_property

GetPropertyResponse.description: Response model for GetProperty action representing a GA4 Property resource.

account.description: Parent account resource name. Format: accounts/{id}; immutable.
account.title: Account

createTime.description: Timestamp when the property was originally created (RFC 3339 format).
createTime.title: Create Time

currencyCode.description: Currency for reports in ISO 4217 format (e.g., 'USD').
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

deleteTime.description: Timestamp when property was trashed (if applicable, output only).
deleteTime.title: Delete Time

displayName.description: Human-readable display name (max 100 UTF-16 code units).
displayName.title: Display Name

expireTime.description: Permanent deletion time for trashed property (if applicable, output only).
expireTime.title: Expire Time

name.description: Resource name of this property. Format: properties/{property_id}.
name.title: Name

parent.description: Parent resource name. Format: accounts/{id} or properties/{id}; immutable.
parent.title: Parent

timeZone.description: Reporting time zone in IANA format.
timeZone.title: Time Zone

updateTime.description: Timestamp when the property was last updated (RFC 3339 format).
updateTime.title: Update Time

GetPropertyResponse.title: GetPropertyResponse
